hero.title: Support Our Mission
hero.subtitle: Your contribution helps us provide critical, trauma-responsive wraparound services to adoptive families at no cost to them.

main.heading: Make a Lasting Impact Today
main.intro: is a program of Revive Behavioral Healthcare. We believe that every child deserves a healing homelife, grounded in love and specialized education.
main.body: When you donate, you directly support families in crisis, enabling them to receive dedicated coaching, parent groups, and in-home support, bringing peace back to their homes.
main.quote: "Together, we use profound resilience and love to overcome hurdles and change the lives of adopted children and their parents forever."
